correctness.rationale: From group identity derive B(1)=1 and B(gz)=B(g)B(z); a commutator-surjectivity argument proves B(Z)⊂Z even without linearity. Quotient map induces Fp-linear L and central term αz+f(v). Comparing f polarizations yields symplectic identity; subtract quadratic −αω(Lv,v)/2 leaving additive ℓ. α=0 and −1 collapse to isotropic-image maps. Count totally isotropic r-subspaces via symplectic Gaussian coefficient, then rank-r surjections V→U and p^(2n) central linear forms. If α not 0,−1 and both images rank n, U=im L, W=im(I+L) split V, L=−P_U and each U,W is Lagrangian; count complements as symmetric n×n matrices. Independently checked complete 243 (L,α) dimension-2 p=3 cases against literal group law for every g,h pair; counts α=0:33, α=1:24, α=−1:33; independently verified p=3,n=2 fiber 20,476,881 and p=5,n=2 fiber 37,781,640,625. Finite checks do not prove general dimensions.

value.rationale: Complete all-dimensional, nonlinearity-free parametrization of an operator class on a natural finite nonabelian group family, including two rank-resolved central-action fibers and a Lagrangian balanced sector. This is structural mathematics supplying exact counts rather than a narrow random enumeration or known dimension-three substitution.

final_claim: For every odd prime p and n≥2, all weight-one group Rota–Baxter maps on the exponent-p extraspecial group G=V×Fp, dim V=2n, have uniquely B(v,z)=(Lv,αz+ℓ(v)−αω(Lv,v)/2), with ℓ∈V*, α∈Fp and ω(Lv,Lw)=α[ω(v,w)+ω(Lv,w)+ω(v,Lw)]. For α=0 or α=−1 the indicated image is totally isotropic; both rank-r fibers have exactly p^(2n)[n choose r]_p∏_{j<r}(p^(n−j)+1)∏_{i<r}(p^(2n)−p^i) maps. For α≠0,−1 and both complementary-image ranks n, maps correspond exactly to ordered complementary Lagrangians, counted by p^(2n+n(n+1)/2)∏_{i=1}^n(p^i+1).
limitations: Odd prime p, n≥2, exponent-p extraspecial group; rank strata specified precisely, not full other-α enumeration.
